entities.summary: Miguel García Vivancos was a Spanish Naïve painter and anarchist. He was a member of the National Confederation of Labor, during the Spanish Civil War he commanded several military units. With the defeat of the Republic he went into exile, where he developed a career as a painter. He was artistically known by his second surname.
